'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Ryan Walter LS Hoth: Main Power Generators''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Walter]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth: Main Power Generators]]
* '''Username:''' RyanNCWA
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
